script_en.hook: You wrote the resignation mail at midnight.
lines: You sent it at 9:14 the next morning because that is when you opened your laptop.
The month mattered to you. The date mattered.
VedicHour shows you when the sky is clearer for messages that change things.
Not which decision to make. When to press send.
A Tuesday morning at 10:35 feels different from 2:47 in the afternoon.
The resignation goes either way. The clarity does not.
